tasks.objective: AdvIn gets a no-login service user `flow`, /opt/flow-gateway (releases, current), /var/lib/flow-gateway (SQLite) and /etc/flow-gateway/env (mode 600, skeleton without values), the gateway and bot systemd units installed and hardened (NoNewPrivileges, PrivateTmp, ProtectSystem=strict, bind only 172.20.0.1 on a free port you record), and the Caddy block for flow-api.185-147-157-25.sslip.io (reverse_proxy to 172.20.0.1:<port> with SSE flush) added to /opt/edge-proxy/Caddyfile and reloaded in the `caddy` container. Rules for every M6 task (owner decision D-078, 2026-10-19: agents ship to production): (1) Never print, log, commit or pass a secret in argv: read secrets from the owner's file `~/.config/flow/secrets.env` (mode 600, outside any repo) and move them over ssh stdin or `vercel env add` stdin. (2) AdvIn also serves other production sites behind the same Caddy: before touching it snapshot the status and TLS subject of every host, back up what you change (timestamped copy), validate before reload, and if any other host answers differently afterwards restore the backup at once and fail the task. (4) If something only the owner can supply is missing or a site asks for 2FA, sudo mode, a captcha or a Cloudflare challenge, stop at once and say exactly which: do not improvise, invent a secret or retry.

tasks.title: Remediate T18 findings F1, F2, F3, F4
tasks.objective:
Fix these confirmed audit findings of T18 (remediation round 1) on the tree already integrated, without rewriting the tasks that built it:
- F1 (high; owned by T15a): The displayed GitHub sign-in route returns 404; the displayed logout route is also absent. Evidence from the audit: Probe A: GET /api/auth/github and /api/auth/logout -> 404; page.tsx:390/412 versus gateway/server.py:60.
- F2 (high; owned by T15d): The shared web command/challenge sender omits X-Flow-Request and all web mutations are refused. Evidence from the audit: Probe A: matching Origin and valid fixture session with the web's headers -> 403 forbidden.
- F3 (high; owned by T13): The gateway forwards the public command schema unchanged to a laptop ledger that requires another format. Evidence from the audit: Probe A: contract-valid pause through both production HTTP handlers -> 400 INVALID_COMMAND. Laptop requires idempotency_key/command/string target/origin/params.
- F4 (high; owned by T13): The gateway has no authenticated challenge-issuance relay, blocking genuine destructive confirmations. Evidence from the audit: Probe A: POST /api/remote/v1/challenges with valid session, Origin and marker -> 404.
For each finding add a regression test that exercises the real entry point, in the test file that this task's verification commands run, and keep every behaviour that works.
tasks.estimate_rationale: 4 confirmed finding(s), 40 min each, on the integrated tree

tasks.title: Remediate T18 findings F5, F6, F7, F8
tasks.objective:
Fix these confirmed audit findings of T18 (remediation round 1) on the tree already integrated, without rewriting the tasks that built it:
- F5 (high; owned by T4a, T15a, T15b, T15e): Production run/plan snapshots use a different dialect from the mobile parser and omit round/decision detail. Evidence from the audit: Probe A: real run_summaries projection emits req_id/status/attempt, not required req/state/activeAttempt; bt_planstatus.list_plans emits summary rows only.
- F6 (high; owned by T12, T15c, T15d, T15f): Required review/quotas/history/routes read paths are not connected; quotas/history remain laptop placeholders. Evidence from the audit: Probe A: authenticated gateway GET review, quotas, commands and routes -> 404; laptop quotas/commands -> unconditional 503; UI history is per-page React state.
- F7 (high; owned by T14b): The Telegram owner-only bot, safe callbacks, inline buttons and /estado are missing. Evidence from the audit: Probe B: sendMessage payload has only chat_id/text. test_telegram_bot.py is absent; its discovery command runs zero tests.
- F8 (high; owned by T6, T14): Production alerts lack several specified event producers and do not establish retry exhaustion before notifying. Evidence from the audit: Probe B: a real attempt_transition failed row produces a no-retries alert without retry facts. Production plan summaries omit decisions; no derivation of completion/round/quota/stall conditions exists in the audited remote path.
For each finding add a regression test that exercises the real entry point, in the test file that this task's verification commands run, and keep every behaviour that works.

tasks.title: Remediate T18 findings F1, F2, F3, F4
tasks.objective:
Fix these confirmed audit findings of T18 (remediation round 2) on the tree already integrated, without rewriting the tasks that built it:
- F1 (high; owned by T6, T12): Resolving an ephemeral decision/round event invalidates the laptop feed cursor; the gateway retries that cursor indefinitely and stops subsequent SSE/Telegram delivery. Evidence from the audit: Real route_get: resolving the last decision changes the previously valid after cursor to HTTP 400 INVALID_CURSOR. Two gateway polls retained and requested the same expired cursor. See audit.md F1.
- F2 (high; owned by T4a, T15c): The production task projection removes non-live failed attempt identity from activeAttempt, while the web renders reviews only for failed tasks with activeAttempt; Telegram review fragments also have no matching page target. Evidence from the audit: task_view on a rejected task with a non-live failed attempt returns activeAttempt=None; page.tsx:417 cannot render its review and does not parse history or handle #attempt fragments. See audit.md F2.
- F3 (high; owned by T13, T5a): Web decision answers are rejected by the gateway type allowlist; requestId/request_id translation and decision-specific precondition reading are also missing. Evidence from the audit: validate_command on the page's answer-decision envelope raises INVALID_COMMAND; the laptop requires request_id and reads run state instead of the open decision. See audit.md F3.
- F4 (high; owned by T5b, T15e): Round answers compare open-round preconditions against plan/run state and send singular answer where the laptop requires answers. Evidence from the audit: Real ledger with a waiting scheduler status and the open-round web precondition returns STALE_PRECONDITION; to_laptop_command retains answer and provides no answers. See audit.md F4.
For each finding add a regression test that exercises the real entry point, in the test file that this task's verification commands run, and keep every behaviour that works.
